text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—*pant*... *pant*...!
As expected of you, Ramonu, but... I won't let you get away!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The one who will reign supreme... is me!
Huh... HAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—
(Waaaaaah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commuter
text_block_list.text: Who will it be... Who is going to... win...!

text_block_list.name: High Schooler
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Everyone's so strong...!
—Keep it up, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh.
Hang in there...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Rudooolf——!!
CB——!!!!
Lady Ramonu~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...I love you.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup has become the showdown of the century!
A race where every single person who loves racing
watched on with bated breath!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The winner is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu!
It's Mejiro Ramonu...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She overwhelms the field with a flawless run!
She has taken down the Classic Triple Crown Umamusume!!
(Waaaaah!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...

"Whenever she ran, she was always like that.
Overflowing with the feeling of 'loving racing'—
of dedicating everything to it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This is it.
This race...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: “—A perfect race... achieved through everyone giving every ounce of their strength.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I wonder... if my love reached them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...How could...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: What a race...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Someday, I will too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Ramonu... you are going
to forge the future with those legs of yours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
I must inform the household.
—Ramonu will run. Until she is fully satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: âRamonu.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no saying 'words aren't necessary' this time, okay?
At least let me praise you!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Ramonu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Thank you, C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Man, they totally got the better of me!
I really thought I had that one in the bag back then, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Today, you were more beautiful
than you've ever been.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Let's both stay true to what we love.
I hope we can meet again beyond that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: We will surely meet.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I bet.
Well, see you on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Ramonu, I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Your running brought out
the best in the race even more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I thank you very much.
Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Is that the end of it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "After all, we will be able to talk anytime in the future."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Right here, in this place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You've decided to enter another race,
haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Once we run together,
you'll understand."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, you can't sacrifice it either.
That love of yours, above all else..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The only thing that matters to me...
is whether you will prove to be a worthy rival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not interested in logic.
If you want to talk, let your legs do it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You really do whatever you want, don't you!

—At the post-race press conference, Symboli Rudolf announced
her return to the front lines.
The reason being...

"I cannot reign supreme while carrying defeat"...
It seems she plans to set a new record surpassing the undefeated Triple Crown,
and then return once more to forging the future.

"I am glad to have learned how inexperienced I still am."
As she said this, her expression seemed somewhat joyful,
hinting at the further growth of the "Emperor"—

Everything was over...
and Mejiro Ramonu was basking in the afterglow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Can you
see it, I wonder?"

Where Mejiro Ramonu pointed with her chin,
there was nothing but an empty turf spreading out before us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Close your eyes... and listen carefully.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The sound of running... the cheers... the breath of the Umamusume.
Kicking up the turf... a raging storm...—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“—A race even more magnificent than today's...
The pinnacle of racing shall be rewritten.”

Startled, I opened my eyes to see Mejiro Ramonu
gazing straight at the turf.
Without taking her eyes off the future for even a second.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
From here on,
racing will only become more refined.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The supreme race manifests everywhere,
and people are driven into a frenzy..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —And I will continue to remain there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Not the soul, or anything like that.
This body, these legs... will wed themselves to the turf until the very end."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Constantly honing my legs, faster than anyone else...
I will embrace the finish line."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I will continue to love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Until this body burns itself out entirely.
